# Codex research fixtures

Invented Codex CLI rollout JSONL (`type` / `payload` / `timestamp`) for `codex-rollout-v1`. Paths are `/workspace/codex-project`. Not a production `~/.codex` chat.

`unfinished-read.jsonl` is a short unfinished session: user asks to read `src/cli.ts` and start a `--quiet` flag; one successful `exec_command` read; one unmatched tool call; a typed `reasoning` item that must not become a decision.
